data.text: CI on PR #8 failed once on Node 22: test/search-relevance 'answers inside the budget on the real corpus' ran 75 searches in 5.1 s and hit vitest's default 5 s for the test as a whole - each query stayed far inside its 200 ms budget (28 ms locally). The journal grew this week (DOC-65, notes), and the loop grew with it. The test now has an explicit 60 s limit; the budget assertion is unchanged. Golden set now 0.76 (19/25) over 65 documents.
